newsitem.title: CHINA: Jintai posts 1996 loss on poor sales.
newsitem.headline: Jintai posts 1996 loss on poor sales.

text.p: Shanghai Jintai Co Ltd, a leading construction machinery maker, reported a net loss of 15.02 million yuan for 1996 under international accounting standards due to poor sales.
The company said it did not provide comparative figures because it was established in July, 1995.
"Demand for the company's main products fell, resulting in weak sales," according to a company statement in Wednesday's Shanghai Securities News.
"Severe competition forced us to lower sales prices, which was another negative factor," the statement said.
"Demand for products with higher profit margins also weakened, becoming the third key reason for losses in 1996," it said.
